gaps.sentence: This small car is very ___ to run.
gaps.explanation: 'Economical' means costing little or saving money; 'economic' relates to trade, industry or the economy.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: They managed to ___ the champions in the final.
gaps.explanation: 'Beat' takes the opponent as object (beat the champions); 'win' takes the game or prize.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: You ___ a lot of water by having such long showers.
gaps.hint: to use something valuable without needing to
gaps.explanation: 'Waste' means to use more than necessary; 'save' means the opposite — to avoid using.

gaps.sentence: The new law will ___ every driver in the country.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb meaning to have an influence on; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning a result.

gaps.sentence: The Titanic sank on her maiden ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Voyage' is a long journey by ship or spacecraft; 'maiden voyage' is a ship's first journey.

gaps.sentence: She has lived in this street ___ 2015.
gaps.hint: starting point of a period up to now
gaps.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time when the situation started and continues; 'for' is used with a length of time.
